answer: One concrete mechanism: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The island of work and the copper of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a reef to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
